invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.

Project is the universal recursive work primitive: task, subtask, phase, milestone and work package semantics are represented through explicit Project identities/relations rather than parallel work primitives.

prose.summary: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define Project as the universal recursive work/task primitive representing projects, tasks, subtasks, phases, milestones and work packages through one identity model. [2] Define Project as the universal canonical work identity used for work at every recursive scale, from long-running engagements to executable leaf work.

semantics.authority_rule: Project existence/visibility does not grant participation or mutation authority.
semantics.employment_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Continuing employment/work relationships may be represented as long-running/composite Projects with recurring child work Projects. [2] A continuing employment/work agreement may be represented as a long-running/composite Project when it establishes recurring work.
semantics.identity_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Every work unit is a Project identity. [2] Every Project has an explicit stable canonical identity.
semantics.instance_rule: Project identity is distinct from UI card, schedule slot, publication or broker listing.
semantics.leaf_rule: Leaf Projects are executable work units.
semantics.ownership_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Project identity does not itself determine human ownership/authorization. [2] Project owns its work semantics; external systems reference rather than clone it.
semantics.parent_rule: Composite Projects may contain child Projects explicitly.
semantics.recursive_rule: Task/subtask/phase/milestone/work-package are represented by Projects, not separate task entity types.
semantics.scale_rule: Project identity is independent from duration, size, organizational level or commercial context.
semantics.universal_rule: Task, subtask, phase, milestone and work package are modeled as Projects rather than separate work primitives.
